read_source_available_via: GET /api/user/profile (already exists; already returns server field if set)
model.semantics: display-only; the value of users.server is rendered as text. UI must NOT interpret the value to allow selection.

fallback_when_user_has_no_server.behavior: locked preview remains identical; no error toast; no retry

avoiding_divergence_with_server_profiles: never compute or assume mapping users.server -> server_profile_id during read
do not write users.server while dual-write is not enabled

future_mapping_into_server_profiles.strategy: seed pack will materialize users.server into server_profiles with archive=False; mapping is created server-side, not client-side
future_mapping_into_server_profiles.compatibility: during dual-write window, both fields are kept in sync; reads can prefer profile_id when present

display_format_in_locked_preview.current_implementation: placeholder text 'Anteprima dual-read in preparazione' (Track E polish)
display_format_in_locked_preview.future_implementation: when auth/contract hardening lands, locked preview can show 'Server attuale: {users.server || none}'
